'''Roast greeg pie''' was an [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] [[Foodstuff/Legends|dish]]. It could be [[Diet/Legends|eaten]] by Ugnaughts and had a smoky scent, a smell that the Ugnaught [[Ugloste/Legends|Ugloste]] associated with his being welcomed home when he lived in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].<ref name="SWTSE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Roast greeg [[Pie/Legends|pie]] was mentioned in ''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] supplement for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' published in [[1995]].<ref name="SWTSE" />
